intro: OptiScaler settings for the next game launch.
remove_confirm: Remove standalone OptiScaler and its settings from this game? Other files are preserved.
install_hint: Installs the official OptiScaler package. Requires a 64-bit Windows game. Existing files are never overwritten.
profile_error: The component changed, but the launch profile could not be updated.
upscaling_hint: The game needs a compatible DLSS, FSR or XeSS input. FSR 4 and DLSS depend on the GPU and available libraries; selecting them does not add support.
latency_hint: Adjust Reflex and LatencyFlex before launching the game. Support depends on the game and installed libraries.
save_error: Could not save. Confirmed values were restored.
saved: Choices save automatically in the game for the next launch.
draft: Choices will be applied when installing OptiScaler.
nr_optiscaler: Detected OptiScaler installed with DLSSNR. These are OptiScaler settings. To install a standalone copy, first remove the existing installation through DLSSNR-AMD.
nr_reshade: Detected DLSSNR using ReShade. This does not confirm an OptiScaler installation. Manage the existing installation before adding another graphics mod to avoid DLL conflicts.
nr_unknown: DLSSNR files were found, but its route could not be confirmed. Review or remove that installation before installing standalone OptiScaler.
framegeneration_hint: Choose the input, output and provider manually. On does not select these options for you. OptiFG requires active upscaling. Use one frame generator at a time.
fg_unavailable: Update the OptiScaler component and its game installation to configure these FG controls.
main_hint: Values read from this game’s OptiScaler.ini. Auto uses the component’s choice at runtime.
patcher_hint: Exposes DLSS/FG options in supported games. Downloads from the official project when enabled; changes apply on the next game launch.
patcher_external: OptiPatcher was installed externally. Manage its files through the original installation.
patcher_loader_off: Files are present, but plugin loading is disabled. Turn this option off and back on to enable loading.
runtime_hint: Official optiscaler/OptiScaler package, independent of DLSSNR. Prepare it here and install through each game’s Mods tab.
runtime_patcher: OptiPatcher is optional and downloaded when enabled in each game’s Mods tab. Disabling it preserves other plugins.
nightly_hint: Downloads development builds from the official channel. May be unstable. The stable package remains stored separately.
channel_games_hint: The selected channel applies to future installations. Existing game installations are not changed automatically. To return to stable, turn this option off and reinstall OptiScaler in the game.
key_record_hint: Use one key without Ctrl, Alt or Shift. Esc cancels.
key_unsupported: Unsupported combination. Use one key without modifiers. Esc cancels.
proxy_hint: Proton will use the selected DLL. OptiScaler.asi requires an external ASI loader and is not installed automatically.
management_hint: Install, update or remove OptiScaler in this game and prepare the official package.
key_description: Opens or closes the OptiScaler menu in the game.
configuration_locked: Install OptiScaler in this game to unlock its INI settings.
package_game_hint: Updates the local package. Existing game installations are not changed automatically.
usage_hint: Prepare OptiScaler and set up PeliRun once in your preferred launcher.
usage_install_hint: In Manage, check this game’s installation. For a standalone installation, download the official package and click Install OptiScaler. This creates the INI file and unlocks the settings.
usage_configure_hint: Adjust the menu, upscaling, frame generation and latency in the categories on the left. Choices save to the game’s INI. Use the key set in Menu and compatibility to open the menu during gameplay.
usage_launch_hint: Use Play in the library. The launcher applies the saved launch options; OptiScaler reads the configuration in the game folder. Restart the game after changing settings.
usage_other_launcher_hint: Prepare the PeliRun command below, select your launcher and copy it into the indicated field. PeliRun applies the launch environment; OptiScaler uses this game’s saved INI. Set up the command once and manage settings in PeliGames.
usage_install_first: Install OptiScaler in this game before preparing the command. If it was installed with DLSSNR, manage that installation through the DLSSNR menu.
fsr_library_hint: The exact version (e.g. 4.1.2) comes from the loaded library. This selector chooses the FSR backend and does not swap DLLs.
fsr4_compatibility_hint: To try GPUs without native support, force INT8. A compatible library is required; RDNA 2 and Lite models depend on the driver’s Vulkan FSR.
software_hint: File presence does not confirm in-game use. Versions without reliable metadata are not estimated.
package_remove_hint: Manage the selected channel’s package. Copies installed in games are preserved.
package_remove_confirm: Remove the downloaded files for {{channel}}? You will need to download this package again for new installations.
native_unavailable: OptiScaler requires a Windows game. Native Linux games are not supported by this integration.
choose_destination_hint: Wait for executable detection or choose its folder before installing OptiScaler.
